why_needed: prevents an A source from becoming an unbalanced q_loc or non-geodesic force

why_needed: ordinary current conservation alone leaves charge hair

clause: ordinary matter couples to e, omega[e], and owned gauge fields only
why_needed: needed for Ward matter-zero and WEP/clock safety
